title: Replace fractional VC0 traffic with exact addressed K/V ingress
hypothesis: The historical fractional-smear VC0 traffic can remain a resident-capacity bound, but it cannot close the exact score32 cluster data path because it lacks K/V tensor addresses, partial-byte validity, and mappings to the 512-bit V fill rows and 128-bit p53/p54 K beats.

direct_comparison.primary_question: What exact on-chip ingress contract is required to connect capacity-driven Llama7B K/V data to the embodied score32 cluster SRAM and producer interfaces?
include: int8 GQA K and V byte addressing for four KV heads, 1024-token tiles, and head dimension 128
complete 1 MiB K/V tile and 128 MiB per-layer byte conservation
bijection and transpose from token-major V bytes to 2048 512-bit fill rows per head tile
transpose from token-major K bytes to corrected p53/p54 producer slots and 128-bit dual-stream beats
resident-cache locality and transient HBM-return transport as separate traffic scopes
explicit RTL ownership and backpressure obligations
exclude: frontier throughput, energy, or area reranking before ingress RTL equivalence

preserves: the 15769-cycle shared-mesh result as a standalone historical-traffic capacity bound
the exact release-coupled VC1 reduction transport gate
withdraws: direct use of historical VC0 writes as exact cluster fill evidence
full-dataflow closure claims based on aggregate VC0 byte equality
frontier recosting before exact ingress equivalence

stages: canonical K/V tensor-address decoder with partial-packet byte validity
1 KiB token-major-to-fill-row V transpose buffer and assembler
2 KiB paired-stream K transpose buffer and dual-stream beat assembler with corrected p53/p54 slot distribution
capacity resident versus transient HBM-return source selection
cluster fill/residency/release and end-to-end ready-valid backpressure
shared-mesh composition followed by remote physical measurement

remaining_abstractions: HBM controller and PHY remain outside the chip RTL boundary.
Transient HBM-return placement and routing are not represented by zero resident-cache remote bytes.
SRAM arrays remain inferred until a compatible macro integration is measured.
